dialogue.speaker: Samwise Gamgee
dialogue.text: Mr. Frodo, you haven't slept since we crossed the slag hills. Let me carry the Ring for just a few hours while you rest your eyes.

dialogue.speaker: Frodo Baggins
dialogue.text: Get back! Keep your hands away from my chain, Sam. It is my burden, and no one else's.

dialogue.speaker: Samwise Gamgee
dialogue.text: I don't want to keep it, sir. I only want to help share the load so you make it to Mount Doom alive.

dialogue.speaker: Frodo Baggins
dialogue.text: You cannot help! You don't know what it feels like—and the Ring will not belong to you, not even for an hour.

dialogue.speaker: Samwise Gamgee
dialogue.text: Forgive me, Mr. Frodo. I spoke out of turn. Sit down then, and I'll keep watch over the ridge while you sleep.

dialogue.speaker: Frodo Baggins
dialogue.text: Just stay where I can see you, Sam. Do not come closer while I am asleep.
